# On This Day

> > A comprehensive historical reference database documenting daily events, famous people, and notable figures from 4000 BC to the present day.

Founded by Bruce T. Goldman, On This Day maintains over 241,000 entries covering historical events, birthdays, deaths, and achievements across world history. The site features curated lists of famous historical figures including Napoleon Bonaparte, Christopher Columbus, George Washington, and modern icons like Roger Federer and Abby Wambach.

## Key Topics

- Historical events
- Famous people and historical figures
- Napoleon Bonaparte
- Christopher Columbus
- George Washington
- Roger Federer
- Medieval history
- Daily historical anniversaries
- Birthdays and deaths
- World history timeline
- 13th century events
- 19th century history
- Top 100 historical figures

## Main Pages

- [On This Day - Today in History, Film, Music and Sport](https://onthisday.com): Homepage: Daily historical events, birthdays, deaths from 4000 BC to today
- [List of Famous People and Historical Figures](https://onthisday.com/famous-people.php): Alphabetical directory of famous people from Napoleon to Roger Federer
- [Top 100 Most Famous People in History](https://onthisday.com/people/most-popular.php): Top 100 ranked historical figures: Napoleon, Columbus, Washington lead list
- [About Us](https://onthisday.com/about.php): About page: 241,000+ entries, team info, founded by Bruce T. Goldman

## Historical Years and Events

- [Year 1000 - Historical Events and Notable People](https://onthisday.com/date/1000): Medieval history of year 1000: Battle of Svolder, Leif Erikson's Vinland
- [Year 1200 - Historical Events and Notable People](https://onthisday.com/date/1200): 13th century events: Treaty of Le Goulet, King John's marriage to Isabella
- [Historical Events in 1800](https://onthisday.com/events/date/1800): 37 historical events from 1800: Volta's battery, Pius VII election
